mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, status, due_date, created_at, updated_at FROM tasks ORDER BY id
SELECT id, title, description, status, due_date, created_at, updated_at FROM tasks WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, status, due_date) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{dueDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, due_date = #{dueDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
